statements.text: Under the guidelines in G.O.Ms.No.31 dated 12-05-2025, spouse cases where both spouses are State Government employees are given preference subject to vacancy availability.
statements.quote: Spouse cases, where both spouses are State Government employees, shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy.

statements.text: The guidelines state that employees retiring on or before 31-05-2027 are not to be disturbed except upon their request.
statements.quote: Employees retiring on or before 31-05-2027 shall not be disturbed except on request.

statements.text: Transfer requests for employees facing pending or contemplated disciplinary proceedings will not be considered until the conclusion of those proceedings.
statements.quote: Requests for transfer of employees against whom disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated shall not be considered until the conclusion of such proceedings.

statements.text: The guidelines also mandate that no relaxation of the ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
statements.quote: No relaxation of this ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
